reviews.x: I really do like this eyeliner.  My only issue is that I would prefer the tip to be a little bit narrower.  I am getting too thick of a line for under my eyes and have to use make up remover on a padded eyeshadow applicator to remove the excess.  Otherwise I would have given it a 5. I love the fact that it doesn't smudge and it looks as great at 5pm as it did when i put it on at 7am!! I'm also thrilled that it doesn't make my eyes itch! I have horrible allergies and am super sensitive.

reviews.t: Hands down best eyeliner out there!
reviews.x: This is the absolute best eyeliner I have ever used.  I suffer from very dry and watery eyes.  This eyeliner stays put as long as you don't rub!  Lasts through my allergy induced watering.  I also frequently have issues with my liner sliding down and transferring to my lower lid, leaving me with dark under-eye smudging.  This eyeliner does not give me any of that!  I have even slept in it and worn it the next day (not recommended). This is my eyeliner for life!!!

reviews.t: I like it because it's dark and it lasts all day ...
reviews.x: The product is exactly as explained in the description. I like it because it's dark and it lasts all day long. The only negative about this product is that it is extremely hard to take off. I have to literally scratch my eyelids in the shower to get (some) of it off. Long-wear is great to an extent. Either way, still a great product and if you like extra extra long-wear, its perfect!
Awesome eyeliner! I wear contacts and have sensitive eyes but this doesn’t bother me at all. Long lasting and sharp lines!

Very easy to appky.  Stayed in place perfectly for over 12 hours until I removed it with my make up remover.  Easy to remove, which surprised me! Will buy again. I started with purching “It’s So Bug”  mascara that I like better than any mascara Purchased for years.
Absolutely love this eyeliner. Stays in place all day. Easy to use. Dries quickly.

So when I opened it for the first time, I noticed spots of black ink in the sink and wasn’t sure how that happened until I put the cap back on and then removed it again. I realized the cap pushes the tip down, pumping ink into it. I’ve never seen an eyeliner designed like that. I think it’s brilliant. It went on beautifully. I had been using NYX eyeliner for the longest because it’s great but as I’m switching everything I own over to organic non-gmo products, this is a perfect replacement.

Goes on smooth and dries without smearing but seems to flake off throughout the day. I think I’ll stick with kat von d’s tattoo liner from now on rather than cheaper ones. Three starts because it’s not horrible and it’s easy to use.
This eyeliner is my favorite next to MAC Liquid Last. The lines are very precise and clean. It's also easy to remove when purposely removing, not harsh on the eyes but also stays put all day.

reviews.t: Super runny. Not a good product
reviews.x: Does not dry within seconds, too stiff of a brush, and when i pulled the tip off black went EVERYWHERE. Super runny. Not a good product. Huge mess.
This is definitely the best eyeliner I have ever used. I love a felt tip but this one is so smooth and allows such small detail. It's the best.

reviews.t: Used it to draw the symbols on my face like on the Mummy 2017 movie
reviews.x: Used it to draw the symbols on my face like on the Mummy 2017 movie. worked like a charm! I will upload pics later

Great product that stays put all day - no color transfer. My lashes and eyelids stay healthy, too. Mostly washes off with soap and water, but I always go over my eyes with eye makeup remover which gets the rest. The only downside is that when you remove it the product pills up, so you have to be careful to get everything otherwise you're left with little black spots stuck in your eyebrows / around your face. It's my favorite eyeliner - much better than some of the prestige brands I've tried.

They aren’t kidding when they say this product lasts all day and doesn’t smudge. In fact, sometimes I have a hard time getting it off at the end of the day. I ended up switching to micellar water and now it comes off a lot easier. Love this product-would highly recommend over any other liquid eyeliner!

This goes on pretty well, but if you are trying to use it under the eye, you've got to reapply it all day long, and when using it on the top of the lid, it leaks down onto the lashes and causes them to gunk up, not exactly appealing.
Was amazing the first week. Now it seems kind of watered down. Either way it’s good for the price. I was surprised at how fast it was delivered since it is a Korean brand.
SO easy to apply! You can apply as thinly or thick as you like. This is a dream eyeliner. I'm obsessed with Mott products now since buying this and her mascara.

reviews.t: The actual liquid dries like a plastic
reviews.x: I don't care for the applicator/brush. The actual liquid dries like a plastic. I prefer a more powdery or matte finish. Not very forgiving of mistakes.

reviews.t: while it was pretty easy to be precise with the wand/tip going on
reviews.x: while it was pretty easy to be precise with the wand/tip going on, it ended up to quite “runny” or “watery.” not terrible, but i wouldn’t buy again.
It's s nice liquid Eyeliner. But it's a small quantity. Too expensive for the size/ you can get an Almay liquid Eyeliner just as good, for less $$

reviews.t: Wish it made me better at applying cateye liner, but overall pretty good formula.
reviews.x: Pretty nice product. Good staying power, but not quite as pigmented as I would have hoped. Overall, I would purchase again due to wonderful price.
I like this product, but it only got a 4 from me because I'm not a liquid fan it did everything it said it will do. I still prefer the pencil.
This eyeliner was runny and it got black all over my makeup case, the contents and my hands  A real mess I had to throw it away on my trip.
I’m the most sensitive person on the planet when it comes to products and chemicals and this stuff causes me no problem! I’m so happy!!
The liner worked fine however the lid is very hard to get off which resulted in the bottom breaking apart. I wouldn’t buy again.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the eyeliner for staying in place and lasting all day without smudging or transferring.
Many reviewers find it easy to apply and use, with some highlighting the precise, clean lines it produces.
Several reviewers note that it can be difficult to remove, requiring makeup remover or extra effort.
A few reviewers report negative issues such as flaking, leaking, runniness, or messiness.
Some reviewers mention the tip or brush, with opinions split between wanting a narrower tip and praising the smooth felt tip.
